metadata.title: VPN Connection Troubleshooting
metadata.heading: Client Diagnostics & MTU
metadata.excerpt: VPN Connection Troubleshooting - Client Diagnostics & MTU: Packet fragmentation causes TLS timeout loops during authentication handshake. Setting MTU to 1360 prevents packet drops on modern macOS and Windows builds.

metadata.title: Password Reset and Account Unlock
metadata.heading: Policy & Password Requirements
metadata.excerpt: Password Reset and Account Unlock - Policy & Password Requirements: Enterprise passwords must be 16+ characters with entropy rules. Dictionary words and previously used passwords from the last 12 rotations are prohibited.

metadata.title: Password Reset and Account Unlock

metadata.excerpt: Password Reset and Account Unlock - Self-Service Automated Flow: Biometric verification or SMS token triggers zero-touch domain unlock. Service desk agents will never ask for your password via chat or unverified call.

metadata.title: Password Reset and Account Unlock
metadata.heading: Sync Latency Notice
metadata.excerpt: Password Reset and Account Unlock - Sync Latency Notice: Replication between cloud identity provider and on-premises domain controllers requires up to 2 minutes. Avoid repeated rapid retry attempts.

metadata.heading: Thermal Throttling Signs
metadata.excerpt: Laptop Performance Troubleshooting - Thermal Throttling Signs: Modern CPUs reduce clock speed below 1GHz when thermal sensors exceed 95C. Inspect fan exhaust ports and high ambient temperature.

metadata.title: Laptop Performance Troubleshooting
metadata.heading: Battery Swelling Protocol
metadata.excerpt: Laptop Performance Troubleshooting - Battery Swelling Protocol: Bulging lithium-ion cells push trackpad upward and pose safety hazards. Units must be depowered and returned to IT Depot for depot battery replacement.

metadata.title: Laptop Performance Troubleshooting
metadata.heading: Memory Pressure & Paging
metadata.excerpt: Laptop Performance Troubleshooting - Memory Pressure & Paging: Memory pressure turning red indicates system is swapping to disk. Recommend allocating memory limits in Docker or closing unused browser tabs.

metadata.title: MFA Authentication Problems
metadata.heading: Push Notification Gateway
metadata.excerpt: MFA Authentication Problems - Push Notification Gateway: Apple APNs and Google FCM delivery can experience regional network delays. Falling back to 6-digit TOTP bypasses APNs latency.

metadata.title: MFA Authentication Problems
metadata.heading: Clock Drift Sensitivity
metadata.excerpt: MFA Authentication Problems - Clock Drift Sensitivity: TOTP algorithms enforce a 30-second time window. A phone clock drift of just 45 seconds will result in repeated auth failure.
